answers.question: What did Zach do for Northrop Grumman?
answers.answer:
On contract with Northrop Grumman since August 2024, through Ayers Software Repair:

- Designed the architecture, SQL Server data layer and integrations for 40+ VB6 applications moved to C# and .NET 8, with no regressions after cutover; about 200 people use them daily.
- Built the release pipeline on Azure DevOps: deploys went from weeks to minutes, with checks on every branch, automated test suites and integration tests.
- Built the AI engineering layer Northrop's developers adopted over several iterations: AI agents, MCP servers and a full harness of plugins, skills and rules that taught AI coding tools the team's stack, code and database.
- Set up an on-premises AI inference server and built the team's own AI agent into its business-facing applications, so business users could ask questions securely.
- Delivered the full port under estimate, with a documented handoff.

answers.answer:
Magpie is a TV and media server that turns the movies and shows people own into live channels with a guide, with apps for phones, TVs, game consoles, desktops and the web.

Built on ASP.NET Core and SQLite, with apps built on Uno Platform. [magpietv.com](https://magpietv.com)

answers.answer: Howland is private AI with a coding agent that runs on your own computer with no internet, beside an offline reference library, on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android. Built in Go. [howland.si](https://howland.si)

answers.question: What is AssembleJS?
answers.answer:
AssembleJS is an open-source framework for micro-frontends and micro-backends composed on the server, with any UI framework on one page and an MCP server so AI agents can build with it.

[assemblejs.com](https://assemblejs.com) | [source](https://github.com/ayers-software-repair/assemblejs)

answers.question: What is RabCab?
answers.answer:
RabCab is order-to-floor automation Zach built at STAK Design: customers designed cabinetry, booths and kiosks in a web configurator, and approved orders flowed through engineering to the shop floor with no manual drafting, leaving engineers free for custom work.

He extended AutoCAD's ObjectARX SDK in C# with custom 3D entities, and kept inventory and costs in sync between the add-in and the website. [getrabcab.com](https://getrabcab.com)

answers.question: What did Zach build for Wrapmate?
